title: Leek and Cheese Polpette
subtitle: in tomato and eggplant sauce
description: Fried leek and cheese balls with a goat's cheese centre and a polenta crust, served over a chunky tomato and eggplant sauce.

steps.text: Cook the leeks in boiling water for 30-40 minutes until completely soft. Drain and squeeze out the liquid well.
Weigh 550 g of cooked leek and chop finely. Add the breadcrumbs, ricotta, pecorino and egg white (not the goat's cheese) and mix to a uniform mixture. Form balls 3-4 cm across.
Shape the goat's cheese into tiny balls (the size of an olive pip) and push one into each ball. Smooth the surface and press the balls firmly.
Put the polenta in a bowl and roll the balls in it. Up to this point they can be made ahead and kept in a single layer in the fridge for 6 hours.
Make the sauce: heat the olive oil and garlic in a wide pot until fragrant. Add the passata and basil, season with salt and pepper and cook for about 20 minutes.

Meanwhile, heat oil in a frying pan for shallow frying. Peel and dice the eggplant 1/2 cm, flour the cubes and fry for 2-3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel and add to the sauce. Cook for 15 minutes over low heat, taste and adjust the seasoning. Keep warm.
Just before serving, heat oil for deep frying in a wide pot and fry the polpette for 2-3 minutes until nicely golden. Lift onto a plate lined with paper towel.
Spoon hot sauce onto serving plates, put 3-4 polpette on each plate and serve immediately.
